name: lumitwin
description: 가상 램프·전장 스마트공장 — 3D 디지털 트윈 + MES + AI 현장 비서

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w shared && npm run generate -w server
scripts.dev:server: wait-on tcp:54332 shared/dist/index.js && npm run db:prepare -w server && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: wait-on shared/dist/index.mjs tcp:8790 && npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start:server: wait-on tcp:54332 && npm run db:prepare -w server && npm run start -w server
scripts.start:client: wait-on tcp:8790 && npm run start -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
